summary: Legacy VB6 banking application with critical modernization needs. High security and maintainability risks due to outdated technology stack and potential SQL injection vulnerabilities.

hotspots.reason: Direct SQL execution with potential for injection attacks, no parameterized queries visible

provenance.evidence: ADO 2.5 library usage indicates direct SQL execution patterns

hotspots.reason: Single login form with no visible multi-factor authentication or modern security practices
Multiple COM components create deployment and compatibility issues
No visible audit trail or transaction logging mechanisms

risks.title: SQL Injection Vulnerability
risks.description: ADO-based data access without parameterized queries poses critical security risk for financial data

risks.title: Technology Obsolescence
risks.description: VB6 runtime and COM components are deprecated, creating support and security update gaps

risks.title: Regulatory Compliance Gap
risks.description: Legacy system likely lacks modern banking compliance features (PCI DSS, audit trails, encryption)

risks.title: Single Point of Failure
risks.description: Monolithic desktop application with no distributed architecture or failover capabilities
